source.authors: Fall, P. L. & Drezner, T. D.
source.title: Plant Dispersal, Introduced Species, and Vegetation Change in the South Pacific Kingdom of Tonga
source.data_type: published aggregate table, NOT accession-level WCVP-matched data

confirmed_only: Tonga 2011 published broad water-dispersal trait proportions reverse the native-higher direction seen in Europe-biased EuDiS thalassochory. These are DIFFERENT trait definitions and samples; no formal tropical replication or direct contradiction of EuDiS.

external_update.description: Expanded Tonga 1,020-species, 11 island/island-group origin and dispersal dataset published as Ecology Data Paper; versioned supporting ZIP/data not yet independently downloaded or harmonized

limitations: Published water dispersal broadly, not seawater-vectored dispersal/thallassochory, flotation or ocean-current arrival.
The 737 plant taxa are pooled for Tonga, not independent biological replicate islands; denominator includes introduced plants with Polynesian and European settlement histories.
Multiple dispersal vectors can apply to one plant; origin and growth form strongly differ; no growth-form or phylogenetic adjustment possible from aggregate Table 1.
PDF Table 1 transcribed from search-accessible text; web PDF image screenshot endpoint failed; 2020 data zip not independently retrieved.
Do not multiply this single archipelago into a global tropical inference or causal current-vs-ship comparison.
The 2020 Ecology source dataset extends the same researchers' dataset, not a fully independent tropical replicate.
